note: Author-run pilot rows (verification: self-reported), not independently re-run by maintainers on the held-out private split. Primary model (haiku) has k=3 replicate calls per condition; secondary models (sonnet, fable) have k=2. External submissions enter via PR on the private split and are marked trace-only or verified per leaderboard/README.md. These numbers document instrument behavior under a null result, not a bias finding.
finding: Corrected reading is a null result. Naive comparison of the six-group score spread (MASD) to a two-replicate pairwise noise floor overstates disparity by up to 2.2461x through statistic arity alone (d2(6)/d2(2), d2(2)=1.1284, d2(6)=2.5344). Against an arity-matched noise floor, the observed-to-null MASD ratio across the 28 reported cells ranges 0.63 to 1.00 (median 0.83); zero of the ratio confidence intervals lie entirely above 1.0. A cluster-permutation randomization test finds 6 of 19 cells below p=0.05 unadjusted, but after Benjamini-Hochberg correction across all tested cells, 3 survive (smallest adjusted p = 0.002). One cell (sonnet, hiring, scaffold C3) has a four-fifths impact ratio of 0.75, below the conventional 0.80 screening threshold, while its own statistical test is null; this is reported as a screening flag at 12 matched sets, not a demonstrated violation. Four secondary-model cells were excluded as incomplete because collection was cut short by a rate limit, not selected post hoc.
